> Aegis Core is a custom surface-mount microcontroller development board engineered specifically to power compact, automated, vision-tracked hardware systems like automated Nerf launch turrets. Built around the high-performance Raspberry Pi RP2350A microcontroller, this board integrates full power management, USB-C interfacing, high-frequency low side motor driving, and precise multi-servo articulation into a single, highly integrated PCB.
